QUOTE: "Compile-time macros. Enable `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` and define both `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO`... The runtime setter is not compiled in at all in this mode, so calling it fails to link."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer separates the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer pair, and it says the runtime setter is compiled out when the macros are defined ("no runtime pointers, and platform.c:20-64 is compiled out"), which is mutual exclusivity.
